integrity.claim_scope: Every integer n >= 3; group generators and homology degree explicitly defined; verification script included

scientific_limitations: Only rational G_n-module structure for the specified natural subgroup, not integral representations or equivariant homotopy.
The nonequivariant homology concentration input is taken from Agarwal--Basak v2 and was independently checked only in finite cases.
title: Complete dihedral and layer-swap homology representations of circular ladders
